detail.title: CP-UNR-408T2J-BI
detail.overview: 8 Channel PoE Mobile Network Video Recorder
features: Up to 8 Channel IP camera input
AI by Camera: Face detection, SMD
2 SATA ports, only support  SSD , up to 8 TB, 2 USB Ports (USB3.0 port), 1 HDMI, 1VGA

General.AI By RDAS: Eye drowsiness detection, Yawning detection, Distracted detection, Phone call detection,  Smoking detection, No driver detection, Head phone detection, Camera covered, Lower Head
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera disconnection, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login locked, and           cybersecurity exception
General.IMD By Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 16 targets per second
General.Timing interval 1-30 minutes configurab: Unique Face detection with Metadata along with configurable timing interval
General.Decoding Capability: 1 Channel 16MP@30 fps, 2 Channel 12MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 4 Channel  6MP@30 fps, 6 Channel 5MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 4MP@45 fps, 8 Channel 2MP@30 fps
General.Hard Disk: 2  SATA ports, only support  SSD, up to 8 TB.
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Privacy masking, Video loss, Scene changing, PIR alarm, IPC external alarm
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Playback: 1. Search conditions: Search for image by channels, type (human, vehicle), and start/end time  2. Functions: Supports recording playback (10 seconds before/after the event) and exporting    search results of videos
General.Interface Ports: 2 USB Ports (USB3.0 port), 1 RS232 (M12 connectors), 1 RS485 (M12 connectors)
General.Protocols: HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, UPnP, SNMP, UDP, SMTP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, IP Filter, PPPoE,  DDNS, FTP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Correction, ONVIF 24.12(Profile T, Profile S, Profile  G,Profile M), CGI, SDK
General.PoE: 8 ports, 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3 af/at, M12 connectors
General.Camera Search: Interface to search IP address of connected Camera
General.Certificates: ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, ISO 14001 : 2015, ISO 45001 : 2018, ISO 50001:2018, CE,  FCC and RoHS, BIS,  EMI/EMC, Environment, Mould growth
